messages:
maya: Hey team — last-minute conflict from one panelist for Tues 3pm. Can someone swap into the frontend panel? Candidate is senior infra, we'd like a frontend pairing for edge-case UX questions.

samir: I can take it if we still want infra+frontend. I have a 2–3pm buffer, can jump into 3–3:40. :+1:

maya: @samir amazing, thank you. Can you also scribe and run the debrief? We usually need notes in the candidate doc within 1hr.

samir: Yep I can scribe. Quick rubric q — do we keep system-design weight at 40% for this role or bump execution to 45%? Role blurb said "hands-on infra" but hiring manager wants some frontend signal.

priya: For senior infra who will touch product surfaces, we usually do 35% system design / 40% execution / 25% culture. If you want frontend signal, make the execution portion include a short DOM/props discussion.

elena: Also flagging: candidate asked for transcript/recording opt-out. Check the consent box on the calendar. If they opt out, make sure scribe captures behavioral + signals but no audio/video copy.

maya: Schedule snippet to update attendees:
```
Event: Senior Infra panel (3pm)
Attendees: hiring-manager, samir, elena (optional), candidate
Scribe: samir
Record: ask candidate - set to "off" if they decline
```

priya: If candidate opts out, use the debrief template link and fill "key signals" sections only. Here's a quick paste of the three anchors we use:
- Signals: problem decomposition, tradeoff reasoning, debugging approach
- Execution: patching/rollout plan + test strategy
- Collaboration: cross-team communication + docs

people-ops-bot: Reminder: debrief template -> https://redwood.company/debrief-template. Please publish notes within 1 hour of panel end.

samir: One more tiny ask — can someone post the eval rubric weights in the interview thread before we start? I'll snap a photo of whiteboard notes in case of gaps.

maya: Done: weights posted in calendar description and in candidate doc.

elena: I'll join as optional and cover product/context questions. If anything changes ping me in thread. Good luck team :celebrate:
